# January metadata

```{r}
jan_metadata_everythingmod <- jan_metadata %>% 
  rename(
    SAMPLE = X
  ) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, sample_type, location_name, depth_category, filter, lat, long, pH, site, year, temp, prok, eukCONC) %>% 
  filter(filter != "postPCR") %>% 
  filter(filter != "NA") %>% 
  filter(location_name != "Soupy background")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingmod %>% 
  mutate(DATASET = case_when(
    grepl("_GR_", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("Gorda", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("_MCR_", SAMPLE) ~ "MCR",
    grepl("Axial", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial")) %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015, 2019)) %>% 
  filter(!depth_category %in% c("under plume", "plume top", "30m above", "above vent", "euphotic", "oxycline")) %>% 
  filter(!sample_type %in% c("incubation", "control")) %>% 
  filter (filter != "GFF") %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE != "62_TAACAC_S14")

regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("BSW","Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
  mutate(
    pH = as.numeric(pH),
    temp = as.numeric(temp),
    prok = as.numeric(prok),
    eukCONC = as.numeric(eukCONC)) %>% 
    mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("Axial", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ site 
    )
  )

up_janmetadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid) %>%
  summarise(
    pH = na_if(mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    temp = na_if(mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    prok = na_if(mean(prok, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    eukCONC = na_if(mean(eukCONC, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(merged_sampleid)

```

# Prepare MCR dataset

```{r}
df_fixed <- deepsea_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) %>%  # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match
 rename(value = `SEQUENCE_COUNT`) %>% 
  rename(H2 = `H2.`)

new_MCR <- df_fixed %>%  # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(DATASET == "MCR") %>% 
  filter(!Supergroup %in% c("Terrabacteria", "Archaea_X", "Bacteria_X", "CMS", "FCB")) %>% 
  filter(!Phylum %in% c("Aquificae", "Euryarchaeota", "Proteobacteria")) %>% 
  filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class != "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)
# removed incubation data, i am only interested in shipboard and insitu samples
  #mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))


mcr_ev <- new_MCR %>% 
  mutate(
    new_class = Class %>%
      str_replace("_X$", "_Unknown") %>%
      replace_na("Unknown")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(supergroup_final = case_when(
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Telonemia" ~ "Telonemia",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Stramenopiles" ~ "Stramenopiles",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Alveolata"     ~ "Alveolata",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Rhizaria"      ~ "Rhizaria",
    TRUE ~ Supergroup   # keep other supergroups as they are
  ))
```

# Prepare Axial dataset

```{r}
axial_df_fixed <- axial_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match


axial_filtered <- axial_df_fixed %>% # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(!Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria")) %>% 
  filter(!Supergroup %in% c("Terrabacteria", "Archaea_X", "Bacteria_X", "CMS", "FCB")) %>%
  filter(!Phylum %in% c("Aquificae", "Euryarchaeota", "Proteobacteria")) %>%
  #filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class!= "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(!DEPTH_CATEGORY %in% c("under plume", "plume top", "30m above", "above vent", "euphotic", "oxycline")) %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)

axial_20s <- axial_filtered %>% 
  filter(AXIAL.YEAR %in% c("AXIAL_23")) 


#length(unique(test_axial_20s$FeatureID))

axial_renamed <- axial_20s %>% 
  mutate(
    new_class = Class %>%
      str_replace("_X$", "_Unknown") %>%
      replace_na("Unknown")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(supergroup_final = case_when(
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Telonemia" ~ "Telonemia",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Stramenopiles" ~ "Stramenopiles",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Alveolata"     ~ "Alveolata",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Rhizaria"      ~ "Rhizaria",
    TRUE ~ Supergroup 
  )) %>% 
  rename(ProkConc = Prok_avg)
```

# Collapse duplicates

```{r}
regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("BSW","Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

new_mergedids <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    total_sequences = as.numeric(value),
    # Create a merged sample ID independent of the original SAMPLE
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  # Group by the real sample (not the original SAMPLE) + FeatureID
  group_by(merged_sampleid, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


new_mergedids_up <- new_mergedids %>% 
  select(FeatureID, total_sequences, merged_sampleid)

filler_data <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, supergroup_final, Phylum, Class, new_class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, LOCATION, SITE, SAMPLETYPE, DEPTH,DEPTH_CATEGORY, FLUID_COLLECTION, vent_assoc, filter, VentField, Species_Annotation)

taxonomy_unique <- filler_data %>%
  distinct(FeatureID, .keep_all = TRUE)

abundance_wide <- new_mergedids %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = merged_sampleid,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0
  )
    
final_table 
new_merged <- left_join(taxonomy_unique, new_mergedids_up, by = "FeatureID")

new_merged_long <- new_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -(FeatureID:Species),   # keep all taxonomy/metadata columns as is
    names_to = "merged_sampleid",  # column name for site
    values_to = "total_sequences"  # column name for abundance
  )

new_merged <-  left_join(filler_data, new_mergedids_up, by = c("FeatureID"))

length(unique(new_merged$FeatureID))

unique(new_merged$merged_sampleid)
```

# Finding vent only asvs

```{r}
test_vent_asvs <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SAMPLETYPE) == 1, SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>%
  ungroup()

test_vent_asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent= any(SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_vent) %>%  # keep only ASVs present in Lake
  ungroup()

test_asvsInfor <- asvs_info %>% 
  filter(also_in_other_st == FALSE)

length(unique(test_asvsInfor$FeatureID))

ventonly_asv <- new_merged %>% left_join(test_asvsInfor) %>% 
  drop_na(in_vent)

length(unique(ventonly_asv$FeatureID))

#asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%
#  mutate(
 #   status = case_when(
  #    in_vent & !also_in_other_st ~ "vent only",
   #   in_vent &  also_in_other_st ~ "nonvent",
   #   TRUE                           ~ "nonvent"
   # )
 # )

asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(in_vent) == TRUE ~ "vent",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == FALSE ~ "resident",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == TRUE ~ "cosmopolitan",
      in_vent == FALSE ~ "cosmopolitan"
    )
  )

length(unique(asvs_vent$FeatureID))

axmcr_actual <- new_merged %>% left_join(asvs_vent) %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(SAMPLETYPE %in% c("plume", "background") ~ "cosmopolitan",
      TRUE ~ status))
```

# Start of donut plots

```{r}
# Donut plot for plume and background
plume_and_back <- new_merged %>% 
  filter(SAMPLETYPE != "vent") %>% distinct()

donutpandb <- plume_and_back %>% 
    group_by(Phylum, new_class, VentField) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences))

#length(unique(donutpandb$FeatureID))

donutpandb <- donutpandb %>%
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    #percent = paste0(round(100 * fraction, 1), "%"),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

bpdonutplot <- ggplot(donutpandb, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill= new_class)) +
     geom_rect() + scale_fill_manual(values = classes_and_colors) + facet_wrap(~VentField, scales = "free") +
     coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
     xlim(c(2, 4)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Background and Plume")

# Donut plot for vent-associated (hosted) taxa
ventassocdonut <- vent_assoc_taxa %>% 
    group_by(Phylum, new_class, VentField) %>%
```

# Table

```{r}
asv_level <- axmcr_actual %>%
  tidyr::unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, Class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species),
    is_ventassoc = status == "resident"
  ) %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, supergroup_final, PHYLUM_CLASS, Species_Annotation, is_ventassoc) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


summary_phylum_class <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]), 
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),       
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences
  )


summary_super <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(supergroup_final) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences
  )

write_csv(summary_phylum_class, file = "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/Summary_PhylumClass_Table.csv")
```
